The '''Seyugi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
The system joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />
